consequence.statement: the capability to configure certificate details in XFCC headers is now available; existing deployments that do not use this configuration are unaffected

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds support for configuring certificate details while populating the XFCC (X-Forwarded-Client-Cert) header.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the evidence states a feature was added but does not name the specific configuration mechanism (field, flag, gate, or component) through which operators configure it; applicability: the evidence does not specify which resources, fields, configuration keys, or feature gates control this new capability, making it impossible to determine which environments are exposed
